semantics.clock: All state changes occur on positive edges, as explicitly specified.
semantics.load: When load is asserted at a positive edge, q receives data; otherwise advance one Rule 90 step.
semantics.transition: For each i in 0..511, next q[i] equals old q[i-1] XOR old q[i+1]; missing neighbours are zero.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior is specified.
semantics.initialization: No initial state is specified; do not initialize q. Tests establish known state by synchronous load.
semantics.between_edges: q retains state between positive edges.

numeric.operation: One-bit XOR, independent of center cell

verification.oracle: Independent per-cell loop implementing the original neighbour rule with explicit zero boundaries.
verification.sampling: Drive at falling edges, check stability before rising edge, check results after nonblocking assignments settle.
cases: single live cells at both boundaries and interior
random loaded states and long evolution
data changes while load is low
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch; bounded timeout; PASS line only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original specifies neither reset nor initialization.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Leave state uninitialized; no correctness expectation before first load.
